evidence: result:the marketplace ref moved from v0.68.0 to v0.69.0; codex plugin marketplace upgrade exited 0; codex plugin list reports 0.69.0 enabled from the marketplace cache; the installed plugin directory is identical to the release asset; the smoke run exited 0

result:in a temporary project with the convention block and .epiq/project.json, a new codex exec session (hook trust bypassed for the run) received the read-back sentence on SessionStart(startup) as a developer message before the stage injection; the project trust entries codex exec wrote were removed afterwards and ~/.codex/config.toml differs from before only in the ref line

result:real sessions with a local-only ledger: (1) mid-task message from another session while told to hold it -> the agent created a ledger issue tagged waiting-on-user keeping the sender name and session id; (2) a new session told only to carry on -> it listed the waiting-on-* issues and reported the held item; (3) asked to reply with the version and to answer a request for a delivery date -> it drafted the informational reply, tried agent-relay (recipient absent, recorded), and left the date to the user as a commitment
